_comment: THE semver ordering fixture (release identity design gate 8). Every reader of release identities is held to it: src/core/update/release_identity.ts compareReleaseIdentities, scripts/lib/change_log.ts compareVersions, and the shell twin deploy/dedalo-image-lib.sh once it orders identities. 'ascending' is strictly increasing; each 'equal' pair compares 0; 'not_identities' must be refused by every reader.
